purpose: Proof-of-concept SFT corpus for the 226M target (M3). Demonstrates the four-shape distillation design (instruction->code, completion, bug fix, reasoning trace). Not large enough to replace the project's planned 28k-pair Tier 1 corpus.

shape_b_completion.notes: First draft failed idempotency on timing decorator and timer context manager (non-deterministic elapsed-time printing). Rewrote both to record deltas into module-global containers and emit only deterministic output. Final: 40 snippets, 34 functions + 9 classes across 8 class-based snippets, 6 self-recursive.

author.train: hand-crafted by MiniMax-M3 (subagent stalled in planning mode)

limitations: Not benchmark-contamination-cleaned. Pairs include common Python problems but were not screened against HumanEval/MBPP/APPS/LeetCode verbatim.
Generation by subagents, not a paid teacher model. Quality is high but not the gold-standard of GPT-4o / Claude Opus 4.
Total ~168 pairs is far below the 28k recommended for a meaningful Tier 1 distillation run. Use the prompts/ folder to scale up with a paid teacher when ready.
